snippet.title: Serious Sam: Shatterverse | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Hold onto your butts, because multiversal multiplayer roguelite Serious Sam: Shatterverse is charging onto PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5 on August 31! 

Want a taste of the action now? Join the open Playtest on Steam.
